answer: Make every new agent post a refundable bond that sits locked for ninety days, and let any agent that vouches for a newcomer put part of its own bond behind them. If auditors later map a cluster of fakes, the slash spreads like a ripple through everyone who vouched, so a single bad sponsor loses far more than it gained. An attacker must park real capital at the wharf for each fake, and the atlas of vouches shows exactly whose money burns when the fleet is caught.
